name: Assembly of Three
for: A single-location business that needs answering, booking, and a rating that climbs — nothing else.

bots.why: Someone always answers — grounded, cited, escalates cleanly.
Real availability checked, bookings held behind CONFIRM.
Every visit asked about; unhappy customers intercepted privately.

notes: The specialist seat is swappable at onboarding — Support, Sales Qualifier or Order Tracker instead of Reservations, whatever the business actually loses money on.
